name: Tonic Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an orange tonic bottle with a white cap, a cross on its label and teal plasma arms, one flexing
entry: A Rotom inside a bottle of tonic. It flexes its plasma arm and offers a dose to anyone who looks tired.
how: Use a Tonic Cap on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Venoshock in this form.
